NPCI International partners with Uzbekistan for UPI payments

NPCI International, the international arm of India's National Payments Corporation, has partnered with Uzbekistan's National Interbank Processing Centre (NIPC) to enable UPI (Unified Payments Interface) payments across Uzbekistan. This collaboration will allow Indian users to make payments using UPI in Uzbekistan. The partnership was announced by NPCI International and NIPC, with the aim of expanding digital payment infrastructure. This initiative follows similar UPI integrations in other countries.
